```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .exp-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .exp-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .exp-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .exp-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .exp-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .exp-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .exp-card {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .exp-card:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
  .exp-card:hover .exp-card-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  /* Gapped vertical divider line */
  .exp-card:not(:last-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      #D4D3EE 0%,
      #D4D3EE calc(50% - 12px),
      transparent calc(50% - 12px),
      transparent calc(50% + 12px),
      #D4D3EE calc(50% + 12px),
      #D4D3EE 100%
    );
  }

  /* Right-pointing arrowhead at center of divider */
  .exp-card:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    right: -4px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    border-top: 5px solid transparent;
    border-bottom: 5px solid transparent;
    border-left: 7px solid #C0BCDA;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .exp-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .exp-card-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .exp-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .exp-sub {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .exp-desc {
    font-size: 0.88em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .exp-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    .exp-card:not(:last-child) { padding-bottom: 32px; }

    /* Gapped horizontal divider line at bottom */
    .exp-card:not(:last-child)::before {
      right: 0;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 15px;
      top: auto;
      width: auto;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        to right,
        #D4D3EE 0%,
        #D4D3EE calc(50% - 12px),
        transparent calc(50% - 12px),
        transparent calc(50% + 12px),
        #D4D3EE calc(50% + 12px),
        #D4D3EE 100%
      );
    }

    /* Downward arrowhead at center */
    .exp-card:not(:last-child)::after {
      right: auto;
      left: 50%;
      top: auto;
      bottom: 10px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      border-top: 7px solid #C0BCDA;
      border-bottom: none;
      border-left: 5px solid transparent;
      border-right: 5px solid transparent;
    }

    .exp-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 14px;
      gap: 0 12px;
    }

    .exp-card:not(:last-child) { padding-bottom: 32px; }

    .exp-card-icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; align-self: center; }
    .exp-label { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .exp-sub   { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .exp-desc  { grid-column: 2; margin-top: 0; }
  }
</style>

<div class="exp-outer">
  <div class="exp-header">
    <div class="exp-header-icon"><i data-lucide="history"></i></div>
    <span class="exp-header-text">My Journey</span>
  </div>
  <div class="exp-grid">
    <div class="exp-card">
      <div class="exp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="code-2"></i></div>
      <div class="exp-label">Pre-LLM</div>
      <div class="exp-sub">Before 2023</div>
      <div class="exp-desc">Every line by hand. Stack Overflow as the go-to.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="exp-card">
      <div class="exp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="message-square"></i></div>
      <div class="exp-label">Early LLMs</div>
      <div class="exp-sub">2023 – 2024</div>
      <div class="exp-desc">Chatbots with session restarts. Claude Projects changed that.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="exp-card">
      <div class="exp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="folder-open"></i></div>
      <div class="exp-label">Agentic Engineering</div>
      <div class="exp-sub">2025 – now</div>
      <div class="exp-desc">Working directory as context. Extensions do the rest.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();

  function equalizeExpCards() {
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.exp-card');
    cards.forEach(function(c) { c.style.minHeight = ''; });
    if (window.innerWidth <= 520) {
      var maxH = 0;
      cards.forEach(function(c) { maxH = Math.max(maxH, c.offsetHeight); });
      cards.forEach(function(c) { c.style.minHeight = maxH + 'px'; });
    }
  }
  equalizeExpCards();
  window.addEventListener('resize', equalizeExpCards);
</script>
```
